text:
Maya: Heads up — noticed viewers can still open the KMS key selector in Projects > Keys even after the Viewer role rollout. They can't save, but the dropdown is visible. :eyes:
Sam: Can you paste repro steps and a screenshot?
Maya: Repro: login as Viewer, go /console/projects/alpha/keys -> click Add key -> dropdown shows key list and 'Select key' enabled. Clicking Save returns 403. Screenshot attached.
Ashley: Likely a client-side gating bug. Backend blocks the write (403) but UI gating is based on a legacy flag that sometimes evaluates truthy. :bug:
Sam: I traced it — roles-service started returning permissions:[] and removed can_edit_project in some responses. UI still checks can_edit_project (legacy) and if undefined it falls back to true. Oops.
Ralph: Also noticed our audit pipeline only logs API calls (Encrypt/Decrypt) and not permission-eval events for UI surfaces. We should record when sensitive controls are surfaced.
audit-bot: [automated] permission-eval project:alpha user:viewer@example.com action:view_kms_selector result:allowed timestamp:1892103450
Ashley: Action items: 1) quick frontend patch to gate on permissions.includes('kms.select') (fallback false). 2) add audit event for permission-eval on the KMS selector. I'll open a PR.
Maya: Can we confirm the keys list doesn't leak any secret material? We only need to show key IDs/names, not material.
Sam: Backend confirmed — keys-service returns id + label only, no material. However the list endpoint currently allows any authenticated reader. I'll add a server-side check to restrict list to roles with 'kms.list' permission.
Ashley: Draft PR at https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4723 includes the frontend gating + audit emit. Requesting review from @Ralph and @Sam.
Ralph: Reviewing now. Suggest adding an e2e that renders the dropdown as Viewer and asserts it is not present in the DOM (aria-hidden or not rendered).
Maya: Added the e2e in the PR. One more: prepare rollback / feature-flag kill plan in case some customers break.
Sam: Feature flag is enabled per-org. If needed we can flip it and kubectl rollout restart deployment/console-prod to force the old bundle. I'll prepare runbook steps.
Ashley: Filing SEC-452 in Jira (labels: security, rbac, p2). Not marking incident since no data exfil; still want a post-mortem entry.
Maya: Thanks team. Once PR merges, let's coordinate a small canary deploy to EU region first. :thumbsup:
